plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/backgrounds/room-46-mine-adit.png, room-46 operation 2, derived and promoted by tools/art/interiors-plate.mjs; frame.json beside the candidate). Every rect below was read off that picture. The walls repainted as broken rock by room-46 operation 4 (plate-02), every timber, opening and stone left where it was (Tyler, 2026-11-09: the walls looked "like dragon scales instead of rocks"); promoted at the same y 170.
walkableNote: THE CHAMBER'S FLOOR, in front of the three openings and the mouth.

scaling.note: ROOM 46'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad was painted 409 tall with his feet at y 807; along Room 34's slope for a near-flat floor (0.26 a row) that is 381 at the band's far edge and 422 at its near.

entrances.note: Back out of the right-hand opening -- by THE WAY BACK, or round from THE PASSAGE ON (doc 107's table).

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees. THE STAKE stands by the right-hand opening (doc 108). The three openings and the way out are the ways.
